title: Ghana Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: Historical flood impacts; modelled poverty impacts to 2050
methodology: World Bank CCDR with climate-risk, economic, and poverty analysis.
limitations: The cited poverty effects are modelled; the coastal and annual flood figures are national-level estimates.

title: Climate-Proofing Northern Ghana’s Future: Investing in Resilient Livelihoods and Infrastructure
organization: National Development Planning Commission (Ghana), prepared for the SOCO project
geographic_coverage: 48 districts across five northern regions and Oti Region
temporal_coverage: Historical droughts 1981–2019; 2024 drought and flood reporting; projection to 2080
methodology: Policy brief reports a mixed-method study with geospatial analysis and interviews involving 210 participants.
limitations: Reported district and event findings are not a national causal estimate; the cited 2080 risk passage does not identify its projection scenario.

title: Ghana’s Updated Nationally Determined Contribution under the Paris Agreement (2020–2030)
methodology: Government NDC setting out mitigation and adaptation actions, institutional responsibilities, and intended coverage.
limitations: The beneficiary figure is a planned reach, not an independently verified result.

title: Ghana’s first biennial transparency report to the UNFCCC under Article 13 of the Paris Agreement
organization: Environmental Protection Agency, Ghana; Ministry of Environment, Science, Technology and Innovation
temporal_coverage: National climate impacts, adaptation progress and institutional gaps reported through 2024
methodology: EPA’s first UNFCCC BTR used an 18-month interagency reporting process with technical and stakeholder review.
limitations: The local vulnerability ranking summarizes a cited 2024 assessment; the BTR also reports local data, funding and capacity gaps.

title: Climate Change Vulnerability Assessment for the Kintampo Municipal Assembly
organization: Government of Ghana, Environmental Protection Agency; authored by Yaw Agyeman Boafo for Foresight Planners and Research Africa Limited
temporal_coverage: Household and qualitative assessment in 2022; historical climate review 1980–2020; projections through 2100
methodology: Mixed qualitative and quantitative municipal assessment, including a 153-household survey in nine purposively selected communities, interviews and participatory mapping.
limitations: Community rankings are based on a purposive, small-area sample and the report’s composite indices; they are not municipality-wide probability estimates.

title: Farmer-herder conflicts in northern Ghana amid climate change: causes and policy responses
temporal_coverage: Climate and conflict mechanisms and local responses reported through 2022
methodology: Case-based policy brief draws on police and chiefs’ records, interviews, cited research and northern climate trends; it is not a national causal estimate.
limitations: The author identifies political, tenure and identity drivers alongside climate and warns local cases may be under-reported.

title: Ghana Disaster Management and Risk Finance Strategy Framework and Implementation Plan (2025–2030)
organization: Government of Ghana, National Disaster Management Organisation, with technical support from UNDP’s Insurance and Risk Finance Facility
temporal_coverage: Regional disaster risk and coping-capacity baseline based on 2021 assessment; framework and implementation plan for 2025–2030
methodology: Regional profile builds on the 2021 PDC-NADMO Risk and Vulnerability Assessment and Disaster Management Analysis.
limitations: Indices are region-level summaries, not district estimates; an approved strategy does not establish implementation or outcomes.
